description: Every branch push runs the full CI on the owner's runner scale set; more than a few at once starve each other past the 60-minute timeout, so this repo limits what the shared preset's :disableRateLimiting lifts.
Main's ruleset takes only a commit with a green ci run: a branch is rebased whenever main moves, so the commit Renovate automerges is the one CI tested.
Frontend npm minor and patch updates merge themselves once CI is green
Lock file maintenance merges itself once CI is green
uv is pinned in CI, release and the Dockerfile: one PR moves them together

The runtime Python moves deliberately (Dockerfile, requires-python, the lock and every compiled dependency at once; 3.14 segfaulted in CI on 6 October), never by a Renovate PR; patch updates of the pinned minor still come
Never automatic: the runtime Python, the test Postgres (tracks production's), and Hindsight (pinned to the spiked, recorded version)
